notes: Profile: federal civil defense archive group managing historical intel + current ops documents.
Primary problem: secure, high-recall search across 200M+ documents with vector index + supervised reranking.
Indexing scale: estimate 180-220M docs, average doc length 1.2k tokens -> projected 30-40TB vector store after quantization.
QPS/latency targets: 200 qps sustained; 95th pct latency < 300ms for short-context queries; tail < 800ms for long-passages.
Cost sensitivity: procurement wants predictable TCO model; prefers committed Dedicated or on-prem license vs per-query hosted billing.
Model preferences: open-source encoders (mix of L2 + PQ-friendly baselines), candidate reranker using 3B-class cross-encoder for top-10 re-rank.
Routing/fallback: must support automatic degrade to CPU-based sparse retrieval when GPU pool unavailable; BCP required.
Security: full air-gapped deployment required for enclaves; HSM/KMS integration mandatory for keys; audit trails for every search request.
Procurement notes: heavy redteam + ISSO review; need to deliver RMF artifacts, FIPS statement, and supply chain attestations.
POC ask: 2-week on-site appliance trial in isolated test lab + baseline throughput report and a reranking accuracy comparison vs current BM25+tfidf system.
Quote from ISSO on call: "We cannot have any egress during the POC — manifests only."
Requirements call 2025-01-29: agreed to provide representative doc subset (10M docs) and labeled relevance set (~5k queries) for eval.
Technical constraints: no external telemetry; metrics export via pull-only agent into their SIEM; retention window for logs 7 years.
Engineering ask: clarify supported quantization formats and ability to run 3B reranker in INT8 on gov-certified GPUs.
Legal/procurement: vendor compliance questionnaire in flight; procurement expects 90-day lead time for delivery after contract signature.
Internal: AE/Jordan to coordinate reference calls; SE/Maya to prepare on-prem installation checklist and sizing guide; CSM Liam to prep onboarding plan.
Stated success metrics: reduce average time-to-find (TTF) by 60%, lower false positive retrieval by 30%, maintain SLA 99.9% availability in enclave windows.
Drive artifacts: initial security FAQ sent 2025-01-31; SOC2 bridge requested — Redwood provided interim attestation.
Recent: Security Deep Dive 2025-02-04 (ff_2025-02-04_SecurityDeepDive) — ISSO asked for HSM key lifecycle chart.
Next demo: scheduled internal dry-run for POC image on 2025-02-18 before shipping appliance to customer lab.
